**Medical Literature Search: ""statin" dementia incidence hazard ratio observational study all-cause dementia"**

1. **Statins, Risk of Death and Ischemic Stroke in Patients with Dementia: A Registry-Based Observational Cohort Study.**
   Authors: Bojana Petek, Hong Xu, Marta Villa-Lopez, Bengt Winblad, Milica G Kramberger, Maria Eriksdotter, Sara Garcia-Ptacek
   Journal: Current Alzheimer research
   Publication Date: 2021-11-04
   PMID: 33327915
   Abstract: Survival in patients with dementia is variable. Statins are a cornerstone of cardiovascular prevention. However, the effect of statins on mortality and risk for stroke in patients with dementia is not clear.
   URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33327915/
